title: The test of the town now says why a picture was refused
items: When the automatic check of the town sees a picture fail to load on a people, horse, wagon or carriage model, or on a building, it now writes down the browser's own reason: the picture could not be read, or could not be decoded.
Nothing in the town looks different. This is the next step in finding why the phone-sized check sometimes reports pictures that would not load.
